literal_meaning: গলা চাপিয়ে রাখা (throat suppressed or voice lowered)
figurative_meaning_bn: স্বর নীচু করা; নীচু স্বরে কথা বলা
figurative_meaning_en: To lower one's voice; to speak in a low tone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গলা চাপা করে বলল, এটা কেউ জানবে না।
বাড়িতে সবাই ঘুমোচ্ছে, তাই গলা চাপা করে কথা বলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He lowered his voice and said, no one will know this.
Everyone is sleeping at home, so speak in a low tone.
note: This idiom is commonly used in informal Bengali speech to indicate speaking quietly, often in contexts requiring discretion.
